ideas_intro: Generates a month of content ideas for one account from its top posts, format performance, best posting times, special days and brand voice. Add the ones you like to the Planner as drafts.
ideas_pillars_ph: comma-separated: education, behind the scenes, product, community
ideas_pillars_hint: Leave empty to infer pillars from the top posts.
ideas_days_approx_tip: Approximate lunar date; verify with the official calendar (±1 day).
ideas_empty: No ideas yet. Pick an account and a month, then press "Generate ideas".
ideas_schedule_suggested_hint: Each draft goes to the best hour on its suggested day (keeping the minimum gap between posts). Drafts are not scheduled for publishing.
ideas_send_note: Account ids, usernames and client names are never sent; @handles in captions are replaced with "@mention".
sd_intro: Days specific to your business on top of the built-in list (anniversary, campaigns, launches). MM-DD repeats every year; YYYY-MM-DD is one-off.
sd_builtin_note: The built-in list (TR and global days) is approximate and editable; it is not an official calendar.
rp_button_tip: Turn this post into another format with AI
rp_transcript_ph: Paste what is said in the reel; the model cannot watch the video.
rp_chain_note: Only the first post is published; the rest go to the notes, post them as replies after publishing.
rp_shortened: The text was shortened to the 500-character limit.
rp_no_accounts: No tracked account can publish this format.
